changelog: Compatibility maintenance for Jellyfin 12.1. Rebuilt for .NET 10 with Jellyfin 12.1.0 and the host EF Core 10.0.11 dependencies. Requires Jellyfin 12.1 or later in the compatible release line; use Orca Engine 1.2.4.0 on Jellyfin 10.11. Install the complete package, including updated ABI metadata. Adds server-side playback progress: the Orca X app can start a playback session, report progress and read its resume position through authenticated OrcaEngine/Playback endpoints, and progress is reconciled with Jellyfin so Continue Watching stays in sync. This is a beta release.
description: Server-side intelligence engine for the Orca X TV app: personalization, recommendations, caching, and centralized administration.
name: Orca Engine
overview: The brain/backbone for the Orca X Android TV client.
